book.name: Mɑɑku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Yesu u Yerusɑlɛmu duɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu turuku kuɑ Bɛtefɑɡi kɑ Betɑnin bɔkuɔ, bɑ turɑ Olifin ɡuurɔ. Yerɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu yiru ɡɔrɑ.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i doo bɑru kpɑɑ te i mɛɛrɑ bɛɛn wuswɑɑɔ mi. Ì n duɑ mi, i ko kɛtɛku buu wɑ ɡɑ sɔri ɡe ɡoo kun sɔnire, i ɡu sɔsiɑmɑ i kɑ nɑ.
Goo ù n bɛɛ bikiɑ mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i ɡu sɔsiɑmɔ, i nɛɛ, Yinniwɑ u ɡen bukɑtɑ mɔ. Mii mii u koo de i kɑ ɡu nɑ mini.
Mɑ bɑ doonɑ bɑ turɑ mi bɑ kɛtɛku buu ɡe wɑ ɡɑ sɔri yɛnu kɔnnɔn ɡɑmboɔ swɑɑ bɑɑrɔ. Mɑ bɑ ɡu sɔsiɑ.
Gɑbu be bɑ yɔ̃ mi, bɑ bu bikiɑ, ɑmɔnɑ! Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kɛtɛku buu ɡe sɔsiɑmɔ.
Bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɡe mɛ Yesu u nɛɛ bu ɡere, mɑ bɑ bu deri bɑ kɑ doonɑ.
Bɑ kɛtɛku buu ɡe ɡɑwɑ bɑ kɑ Yesu dɑɑwɑ. Mɑ bɑ ben yɑbenu potirɑ bɑ tɛriɑ ɡen wɔllɔ, mɑ Yesu u nu sinɑri.
Tɔn dɑbinu nu nin yɑbenu tɛriɑ swɑɑ sɔɔ, mɑ ɡɑbɑ mɑɑ bɑ̃ɑ kɑkosu bɔɔrimɔ bɑ tɛriɑmɔ swɑɑ mi.
Be bɑ nùn ɡbiiye kɑ be bɑ nùn swĩi biruɔ, bɑ ɡbɑ̃sukumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, “Bɑrukɑ! U sɑ̃ɑwɑ domɑruɡii wi u sisi Yinnin yĩsiru sɔɔ.
Domɑruɡirɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑ Dɑfidin bɑn te tɑ sisi. Bu Gusunɔ siɑro wɔllɔ!”
Yerɑ Yesu u Yerusɑlɛmu duɑ u dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, mɑ u ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro mɛɛrɑ u kɑ sikerenɑ. Adɑmɑ ye u wɑ yɑm tĩrɑ u yɑrɑ u dɑ Betɑni ɡiɑ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye.
Yesu u dɑ̃ru ɡɑru bɔ̃rusi
Yen sisiru, ye bɑ doonɑ Betɑnin di, yerɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ Yesu mɔ̀.
Mɑ u dɑ̃ru ɡɑru wɑ sɑrun di te bɑ mɔ̀ fiɡie tɑ wurusu kpɑre. U dɑ mi, u kɑ wɑ nɡe tɑ mɑrɑ. Adɑmɑ ye u turɑ mi, u ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu wɑ mɑ n kun mɔ wurusu yèn sɔ̃ sɑnɑm mɛ, mu ǹ sɑ̃ɑ ten mɑrubun sɑɑ.
Yesu tu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡoo kun mɑɑ ten binu dimɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ mɑɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ.
Yesu u duɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ turɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Yesu u dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Mɑ u be bɑ kiɑru dɔrɑmɔ kɑ be bɑ dwemɔ mi ɡirɑm wɔri. U be bɑ ɡobi kɔsimɔn tɑbulubɑ fukurɑ, kɑ totobɛrɛ dɔrobun kitɑnu.
U ǹ mɑɑ dere ɡoo u kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu bukiɑnɑ sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi.
Yerɑ u tɔn be sɔ̃ɔbu wɔri u nɛɛ, bɑ yoruɑ mɑ Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, “Win diru tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑnɑrun diru tɔmbu kpuron sɔ̃.” Adɑmɑ bɛɛ i tu kuɑ ɡbɛnɔbun wɑ̃ɑ yeru.
Ye yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ bɑ swɑɑ kɑsu bu kɑ Yesu ɡo. Adɑmɑ bɑ nùn bɛrum sɑ̃ɑ domi tɔn wɔru ɡe, ɡɑ biti soorɑ win keu sɔ̃ɔsibun sɔ̃.
Ye sɔ̃ɔ kpɑ, Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ yɑrɑ wuun di.
Yesu kɑ dɑ̃ɑ te tɑ ɡberɑn ɡɑri
Yen sisiru bururu, nɡe mɛ bɑ sɑrɔ, bɑ dɑ̃ɑ te Yesu u bɔ̃rusi mi wɑ tɑ ɡberɑ mɑm mɑm sere kɑ ten ɡbiniɔ.
Yerɑ Piɛɛ u yɑɑyɑ ye Yesu rɑɑ ɡeruɑ mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni ɑ fiɡie ye mɛɛrio ye ɑ bɔ̃rusi, wee yɑ ɡberɑ.
Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i de i n Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑɑwure wi u ɡuu teni sɔ̃ɔmɔ tu seewo tu tii sure nim wɔ̃ku sɔɔ, mɑ u kun sikɑ sikɑ mɔ̀ win ɡɔ̃ruɔ kpɑ u n nɑɑnɛ doke ye u ɡerumɔ sɔɔ mɛyɑ n koo mɑɑ nùn koorɑ.
Yenin sɔ̃nɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɡɑ̃ɑnu bɑɑnire ni i bikiɑmɔ kɑnɑru sɔɔ, i nɑɑnɛ dokeo mɑ i nu wɑ i mwɑ kɔ, mɛyɑ n koo mɑɑ bɛɛ kuɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ i yɔ̃ i kɑnɑru mɔ̀, ì n ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔɔsinɛ kɑ ɡoo, i ɡinɑ yɛ̃ro suuru kuo, kpɑ bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ u mɑɑ bɛɛ bɛɛn torɑnu suuru kuɑ. [
Adɑmɑ bɛɛ, ì kun ɡɑbu suuru kue, bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ, u ǹ koo mɑɑ bɛɛ bɛɛn torɑnu suuru kuɑ.]
Mɑn diyɑ Yesu u yiiko wɑ
N wee, bɑ kpɑm wurɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Nɡe mɛ Yesu u bɔsu sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ nɑ win mi,
bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, weren yiikowɑ ɑ kɑ yeni mɔ̀. Wɑrɑ nun yiiko wɛ̃ ɑ kɑ yenin bweseru ko.
Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, kon bɛɛ ɡɑri tiɑ ɡɑɑ bikiɑ. Ì n kpĩɑ i mɑn ye wisɑ, sɑnɑm mɛyɑ kon bɛɛ sɔ̃ yiiko ye nɑ kɑ yeni mɔ̀.
Bɑtɛmu ye Yohɑnu u mɔ̀, weren yiikowɑ u kɑ mɔ̀. Gusunɔɡiɑ? Nɡe tɔnuɡiɑ. I mɑn wisio.
Mɑ bɑ wesiɑnɑ ben tii tiinɛ sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑ sɑ ko nùn wisi. Tɛ̃ nɔ? Sɑ̀ n ɡeruɑ sɑ nɛɛ Gusunɔn yiikowɑ, u koo nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ǹ Yohɑnu nɑɑnɛ doke.
Sɑ̀ n mɑɑ ɡeruɑ sɑ nɛɛ, tɔnuɡiɑ, to. N deemɑ bɑ tɔmbun bɛrum mɔ domi tɔmbu kpurowɑ bɑ wurɑ kɑm kɑm mɑ Yohɑnu u sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ Yesu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ yɛ̃. Mɑ Yesu mɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛnɑ kun mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ wìn yiiko nɑ kɑ yeni mɔ̀.
